technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9, Supertrend, PSAR) show bullish bias, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud with weak trend strength (ADX 19.98), limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 25 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and conflicting (one small purchase, one larger sale months ago); market fear (40 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (400.48) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event creates severe macro headwinds; earnings in 25 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI-9, Supertrend, PSAR bullish) with price near support (106.76) offers tactical entry in fear-driven market (VIX crisis) where contrarian opportunity exists.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price structurally below all key moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), Ichimoku cloud, and Hull MA with weak trend strength (ADX 19.98), zero fundamental conviction, earnings binary in 25 days, and macro headwinds (VIX 400+, flat yield curve) make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI-9, Supertrend, PSAR) shows tactical bullish bias at support, and VIX crisis creates contrarian opportunity.
